research.title: Benchmark of Multimodal Vision-Language Models for Damage Detection
research.venue: LatinX in Computer Vision (LXCV) Workshop · CVPR 2026 · Denver
research.authors: With Mariana Risco Cosavalente and Prof. Claudio Jung (UFRGS)
research.summary: We evaluated CLIP, SigLIP, SigLIP2 and FuseLIP for disaster damage detection on CrisisMMD and DamageDataset, comparing contrastive fine-tuning, two-stage few-shot adaptation and multimodal fusion. Combining image and text consistently outperformed either modality alone, and fine-tuning raised SigLIP's F1 from 0.19 to 0.90.

aiWork.intro: I use AI as a working tool every day — at Canvia and in my own projects — with the same discipline as any engineering practice: clear scope, tests and human review before every delivery.

items.title: Coding agents with a controlled workflow
items.text: Claude Code, Codex and Pi on Gentle Shell and Gentle AI, following ODD (Organic Driven Development): explore before changing, subagents to implement and verify, TDD and risk-based review before every commit.

items.title: Persistent memory
